newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian G-Bank and unit buy into French FP Consult.
newsitem.headline: Belgian G-Bank and unit buy into French FP Consult.

text.p: Belgium's Generale Bank said in a statement that jointly with its unit Fimagest it had taken a 44.3 percent stake in Paris-based firm FP Consult SA.
FP Consult was set up in 1989 to manage portfolios and to advise on portfolio management, it said.
The French company had also developed expertise in emerging markets.
After the deal, 34.8 percent of FP Consult's capital remained with UE-CIC and 20.9 percent with the management, it said.
"This operation comes within... the strategy of specialising in certain financial (areas) developed by the group," Generale Bank's statement said.
These involved completing the bank's range of products with emerging market funds, acquiring new institutional clients and developing highly profitable products.
The Generale Bank group deals with about 1,700 billion Belgian francs in its asset management and is the 15th in the ranking of European fund managers, the statement said.
